# Hats on your own player in third person (back and front): bare, on a player head, a zombie head and an iron helmet,
# after a respawn and in the Nether, and in the inventory. On a worn head the hat must sit on top (no head corners
# poking up through the top hat's brim or the cap's edge, the flower crown's vine showing all round).
# Run it for both versions, and with -f mod_ref=main to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/hats96 -f version=26.3 -f script=.github/checks/hats.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/hats96 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/hats.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set noon
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
cmd gamerule doImmediateRespawn true
cmd gamerule immediate_respawn true
cmd effect give @p minecraft:resistance 600 255 true
set hatPulse true
set hat TOP_HAT
view 1
look 0 25
sleep 10
shot hats-top-hat-back
view 2
look 0 -25
sleep 3
shot hats-top-hat-front

# A player head: top hat, flower crown, propeller cap
cmd item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:player_head
sleep 3
shot hats-top-hat-player-head
set hat FLOWER_CROWN
sleep 3
shot hats-flower-player-head
set hat PROPELLER_CAP
sleep 3
shot hats-cap-player-head

# A zombie head: top hat and shades
cmd item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:zombie_head
set hat TOP_HAT
sleep 3
shot hats-top-hat-zombie-head
set hat SHADES
sleep 3
shot hats-shades-zombie-head

# An iron helmet, as before
cmd item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:iron_helmet
set hat TOP_HAT
sleep 3
shot hats-top-hat-helmet
cmd item replace entity @p armor.head with minecraft:air

# After a respawn (press Respawn in case the gamerule didn't take)
set hat FLOWER_CROWN
cmd kill @p
sleep 4
press Respawn
sleep 5
view 2
look 0 -25
sleep 3
shot hats-after-respawn

# In the Nether, in a cleared pocket on an obsidian floor
cmd effect give @p minecraft:resistance 600 255 true
cmd execute in minecraft:the_nether run tp @p 0 100 0
sleep 8
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-3 ~ ~-3 ~3 ~3 ~3 minecraft:air
cmd execute as @p at @p run fill ~-3 ~-1 ~-3 ~3 ~-1 ~3 minecraft:obsidian
sleep 4
set hat PROPELLER_CAP
view 2
look 0 -25
sleep 3
shot hats-nether
view 1
look 0 25
sleep 3
shot hats-nether-back

# The inventory's player preview, then back to first person
inventory
sleep 3
shot hats-inventory
close
view 0
set hat NONE
